label.en: From memory: what is normal lung made of?
label.zh: 凭记忆：正常肺组织由什么构成？

hint.en: Think conducting airways (bronchi → bronchioles) and gas-exchange units (alveoli); alveolar septa are thin.
hint.zh: 想导气管道（支气管→细支气管）和换气单位（肺泡）；肺泡隔很薄。

label.en: From memory: which cancers are common in the lung?
label.zh: 凭记忆：肺部常见的癌有哪些类型？

hint.en: Adenocarcinoma and squamous cell carcinoma are the common non-small cell types; small cell carcinoma also exists.
hint.zh: 常见的是非小细胞的腺癌和鳞癌；还有小细胞癌。

label.en: Confirm this is lung tissue (open airspaces, thin septa, airways)
label.zh: 确认切片是肺组织（开放肺泡腔、薄肺泡隔、气道）

hint.en: At 2×, normal lung shows mostly open alveolar spaces with thin septa, plus bronchi/bronchioles and vessels.
hint.zh: 2× 下正常肺大部分是开放的肺泡腔、薄肺泡隔，另有支气管/细支气管和血管。

label.en: Systematic low-power scan: sweep the whole section; flag dense, basophilic areas where the open-airspace pattern is lost — then zoom in to check
label.zh: 低倍系统扫查：扫完整张组织，标记深染密集、肺泡结构消失的可疑区——再放大确认

hint.en: Tumour usually reads at low power as a cellular, blue-purple area that effaces the open-airspace pattern. Find it at 2–4× first; confirm morphology at 10×+.
hint.zh: 肿瘤在低倍下通常是一片细胞密集、蓝紫深染、肺泡结构消失的区域。先在 2–4× 找到它，再到 10×+ 确认形态。

label.en: Confirm H&E staining and assess section quality
label.zh: 确认 H&E 染色并评估制片质量

hint.en: These are frozen sections — expect ice-crystal artefact, folds and poorer morphology; do not overcall artefact as tumour.
hint.zh: 这些切片是冰冻切片——会有冰晶伪影、折叠和较差的形态；别把伪影当成肿瘤。

label.en: Weigh age, sex and smoking history into a preliminary call
label.zh: 结合年龄、性别、吸烟史做初步判断

hint.en: Squamous cell carcinoma is strongly smoking-associated (80–90%); adenocarcinoma is also the most common lung cancer in never-smokers.
hint.zh: 鳞癌与吸烟强相关（80–90%）；腺癌也是从不吸烟者中最常见的肺癌。

label.en: Architecture: open alveolar spaces preserved vs effaced by solid cellular areas
label.zh: 结构：开放肺泡结构保留 vs 被实性细胞区取代

hint.en: Normal lung keeps open airspaces; adenocarcinoma forms glands/papillae, squamous forms nests and sheets — both efface the architecture.
hint.zh: 正常肺保持肺泡腔开放；腺癌形成腺样/乳头状结构，鳞癌形成巢状/片状——两者都破坏正常结构。

label.en: Glandular differentiation: gland/tubule formation, mucin, growth along alveolar walls (lepidic)
label.zh: 腺体分化：腺样/管状结构、黏液、沿肺泡壁生长（lepidic）

hint.en: Gland formation, mucin production or lepidic growth along pre-existing alveolar walls points to adenocarcinoma.
hint.zh: 腺样结构形成、产黏液，或沿原有肺泡壁的 lepidic 生长，指向腺癌。

label.en: Squamous differentiation: keratinization (keratin pearls), intercellular bridges
label.zh: 鳞状分化：角化（角化珠）、细胞间桥

hint.en: Keratinization — dense orange-pink keratin pearls — and intercellular bridges point to squamous cell carcinoma.
hint.zh: 角化——致密的橙粉色角化珠——和细胞间桥，指向鳞癌。

label.en: Cytology: crowded pleomorphic nuclei, mitoses, necrosis
label.zh: 细胞：密集异型核、核分裂、坏死

hint.en: Crowded, pleomorphic nuclei with mitotic figures and necrosis support malignancy over normal or reactive tissue.
hint.zh: 密集的多形性核、核分裂象和坏死支持恶性，而非正常或反应性改变。

label.en: Before calling normal: the WHOLE section shows uniform open alveoli, thin septa, no dense cellular foci
label.zh: 判正常前：确认整张切片肺泡腔均一开放、隔薄、没有细胞密集灶

hint.en: Only call normal after scanning the entire tissue — a normal section shows open airspaces and thin septa throughout, without focal dense areas.
hint.zh: 扫完整张组织后才能判正常——正常切片应全片肺泡腔开放、肺泡隔薄，没有局灶性深染密集区。

label.en: Sanity check: does your conclusion have annotated evidence to stand on?
label.zh: 回查：你的结论有标注证据支撑吗？
